content.title: Requirements Response Matrix
content.content:
This section provides SnapLogic's response to {{customer_name}}'s vendor qualification requirements with supporting evidence and rationale for each requirement.

[IMAGE:assets/images/customer/airbus_vendor_profile/Screenshot 2026-04-27 at 21.21.23.png:Requirements Response Summary]

**Requirements Response Summary**

[KPI:jade|Total Requirements|47]
[KPI:jade|Requirements Met|47]
[KPI:jade|Compliance Rate|100%]

All vendor qualification requirements have been addressed with supporting evidence provided in Sections 1 and 2 of this document. The table below provides a high-level summary of requirements by category.

[TABLE:accent-blue:Requirements by Category]
| # | Category | Requirement Count | Response Status | Notes |
|---|----------|-------------------|-----------------|-------|
| 1 | Company Profile & Stability | 8 | ✓ All Met | Section 1.1–1.3 |
| 2 | Aerospace Experience & Compliance | 6 | ✓ All Met | Section 1.4–1.5 |
| 3 | Professional Services Capability | 5 | ✓ All Met | Section 1.6 |
| 4 | Platform Architecture & Deployment | 10 | ✓ All Met | Section 2.1–2.2 |
| 5 | Security & Data Governance | 12 | ✓ All Met | Section 2.5 |
| 6 | Monitoring & Operations | 6 | ✓ All Met | Section 2.4 |
| **Total** | | **47** | **✓ 47 Met** | **100% compliance** |
[/TABLE]

**Detailed Requirement Mapping**

For each requirement category, detailed evidence and rationale are provided in the corresponding sections:

**Company Profile & Stability** (Requirements 1-8)
- Company founding date, headquarters location, global presence → Section 1.1
- Financial stability, investor backing, revenue model → Section 1.3
- Customer base size, enterprise customer count → Section 1.1
- Leadership team experience and background → Section 1.2

**Aerospace Experience & Compliance** (Requirements 9-14)
- Aerospace manufacturing deployment experience → Section 1.4
- Security certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001) → Section 1.5
- GDPR compliance and data residency support → Section 1.5
- ITAR compliance capability (on-premises deployment) → Section 1.5

**Professional Services Capability** (Requirements 15-19)
- PS team size and geographic coverage → Section 1.6
- EMEA/DACH delivery capability → Section 1.6
- Engagement models and partner ecosystem → Section 1.6
- Implementation methodology and timeline → Section 1.6

**Platform Architecture & Deployment** (Requirements 20-29)
- On-premises deployment capability (Ground Plex) → Section 2.2
- Data sovereignty and no cloud data transit → Section 2.1, 2.2
- OpenShift/Kubernetes deployment support → Section 2.2
- High availability and disaster recovery → Section 2.2

**Security & Data Governance** (Requirements 30-41)
- Encryption at rest and in transit → Section 2.5
- SSO, MFA, RBAC support → Section 2.5
- Audit logging and compliance reporting → Section 2.5
- Data masking and quality validation → Section 2.5

**Monitoring & Operations** (Requirements 42-47)
- Real-time monitoring and alerting → Section 2.4
- Integration with enterprise monitoring tools → Section 2.4
- Performance metrics and capacity planning → Section 2.4
- Log export and syslog integration → Section 2.4

[BOX:info]
**Detailed Requirements Matrix Available**

A comprehensive Excel spreadsheet providing line-by-line responses to all 47 requirements with evidence, supporting documentation references, and compliance status is available as a separate deliverable upon request.
[/BOX]
